You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies an algorithm for computing a rooted spanning tree of an undirected graph with a distinguished root node. The state consists of a parent function `mom` and a distance function `dist`; initially every node points to itself, the root has distance 0, and all other nodes have distance `MaxCardinality`, which serves as a finite stand-in for infinity. The algorithm repeatedly chooses a node and a neighbor with a shorter distance and decreases the node's distance to an arbitrary intermediate value while updating its parent. It defines a safety property stating that termination implies a postcondition characterizing a correct rooted spanning tree, a liveness property stating eventual termination, and an additional temporal property asserting that every node eventually has the root as its parent. The algorithm includes weak fairness on `Next` in `Spec`.
